concept: FSx for Windows File Server: SMB and Active Directory integration
tests: Choosing a managed shared file system for a Windows application using SMB with AD integration.
expected: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server — managed SMB file system with native Windows features and Active Directory integration. Triggers: "Windows-based", "SMB", "Active Directory".
why_not: EFS — NFS for Linux; S3 — object storage without SMB; EBS Multi-Attach — block storage for multiple instances, not a Windows file share.
